reply_text:
I replied to Ysolde in your direct message to confirm the change: Bay 47 is now her dock for Sableness Tire Supply pickups on the Nettle project.

I haven't confirmed that the brain stored it. The brain is supposed to save direct messages automatically and show them only to the member who sent them, but when I searched right after her message, it didn't find the fact. The search is running in a limited keyword-only mode, so the save may just not have shown up yet. I didn't save it to the brain myself because that save tool didn't make clear whether a manual entry would stay visible only to her. I didn't post it anywhere else either.
